titles.COMMAND_UNCONFIRMED: Unconfirmed command on point {point_code}: no response from the device within the expected delay
titles.DATA_QUALITY_CLOCK_SUSPECT: Suspicious timestamp on point {point_code}: reading dated in the future
titles.DATA_QUALITY_LOW_TRUST: Rules not evaluated on point {point_code}: insufficient trust score ({score}/100)
titles.DATA_QUALITY_OUT_OF_RANGE: Value outside the sensor's physical range on point {point_code}
titles.RULE_DESIRED_STATE_DIVERGENCE: Deviation between actual and desired state on point {point_code}: value {actual}, expected value {desired}

actions.COMMAND_UNCONFIRMED: Check that the test device is reachable, then send the command again.
actions.COMMUNICATION_OFFLINE: Check power, network connection and the on-site Edge device.
actions.DATA_QUALITY_CLOCK_SUSPECT: Check the clock of the gateway or sensor. Rules are not applied to this value.
actions.DATA_QUALITY_LOW_TRUST: Check the sensor before relying on the alarms of this point.
actions.DATA_QUALITY_OUT_OF_RANGE: Check the sensor and its wiring. Rules are not applied to this value.
actions.FINDING_UNCLASSIFIED: Review the evidence of the finding.
actions.RULE_DESIRED_STATE_DIVERGENCE: Check the time schedule and the operation of the equipment.
actions.RULE_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED: Check the operation of the equipment concerned.
